CustomField.label: State
CustomField.description: CANDIDATE = suggested, not yet confirmed. UNILATERAL = a leg is missing, incompatible or only partly authorized at confirmation time; the principal is never neutralized. CONFIRMED = pair confirmed, principal neutralized. REVERSED = only ever set on a new compensating record created by reverse(); the CONFIRMED record it points to (AXF_ITR_LKP_OriginalTransfer__c) is never edited (AXF-32).
